title: Notifications
emptyBody: Offers, messages and deal updates will show up here.

settings.title: Notification settings
settings.pushHint: Messages, offers, deals and reviews on this phone. Everything still shows in Notifications.
settings.blocked: Notifications are off for this app in your phone's settings.
settings.unsupported: This version of the app can't show push notifications yet. You'll still see everything in Notifications.

explainer.title: Know when they reply

body.enquiry: Your enquiry is sent. Get a notification when the seller replies, so you don't miss a good part.
body.offer: Your offer is sent. Get a notification when the seller accepts, counters or replies.
body.publish: Your listing is up. Get a notification when a buyer enquires or makes an offer.
body.chats: Get a notification for new messages, offers and deal updates, even when the app is closed.

explainer.note: Turn them off any time in Profile.
explainer.denied: Notifications stay off. You can turn them on in your phone's settings.
